entities.name: Query protein (426 aa)
observations: 426-aa sequence has 36.8% identity and 95.5% query coverage to reviewed human FMO5 UniProt P49326 (E-value 1.88e-84); functional assignment is homology-based.
Sequence has Pfam FMO-like domain PF00743 at residues 3–412 (i-Evalue 3.1e-84).
Likely FAD-dependent Baeyer–Villiger monooxygenase; exact substrate specificity is not resolved by homology.

entities.name: FMO5 (human, P49326)
observations: Reviewed human flavin-containing monooxygenase 5; annotated to catalyze Baeyer–Villiger oxidation of carbonyl compounds, inserting oxygen adjacent to a carbonyl to convert ketones to esters.
FAD cofactor; curated annotations include heptan-2-one + NADPH + O2 + H+ → pentyl acetate + NADP+ + H2O and related ketone substrates.

entities.name: Baeyer-Villiger oxidation
observations: General reaction: ketone + NADPH + O2 + H+ → ester + NADP+ + H2O; an oxygen atom is inserted into the C–C bond adjacent to the carbonyl. Substrate varies; exact query-protein substrate is unconfirmed.
